title: FIND: A Function Description Benchmark for Evaluating Interpretability Methods
reasoning: The paper includes a brief 'Ethics statement' section (Section B, page 15) that discusses potential issues such as sensitive topics in the benchmark data and learned biases within LLMs. However, this section clarifies that the FIND evaluation protocol does not test the ability to discover biases beyond those explicitly included (via corruptions to function subdomains), and it serves as a disclaimer rather than a primary component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
